(let [definition (dabstep.payments/fraud-definition)
      agg (loop [cursor nil m {}]
            (let [p (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"])
                  rows (get p "rows") nc (get p "next_cursor")
                  m2 (reduce (fn [a r]
                               (let [c (get r 0) amt (or (get r 1) 0.0) f (get r 2)
                                     old (get a c {:total 0.0 :fraud-vol 0.0 :fraud-count 0})]
                                 (assoc a c {:total (+ (:total old) amt)
                                             :fraud-vol (+ (:fraud-vol old) (if f amt 0.0))
                                             :fraud-count (+ (:fraud-count old) (if f 1 0))})))
                             m rows)]
              (if nc (recur nc m2) m2)))]
  (return {:definition definition :by-country (mapv (fn [[c v]] {:country c :total (:total v) :fraud-volume (:fraud-vol v) :fraud-count (:fraud-count v) :rate (/ (:fraud-vol v) (:total v))}) agg)}))

(return {"problems" ["The analyzer selects NL by raw fraudulent_volume, but its own ratio calculation shows BE has the highest fraud ratio (263833.85/2150473.54 ≈ 12.2684%) versus NL (329134.08/2701907.13 ≈ 12.1815%). It therefore does not apply the relevant fraud comparison metric and the candidate answer should be B. BE, not A. NL."]})

(let [stats (loop [cursor nil totals {}]
              (let [page (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"])
                    rows (get page "rows")
                    totals2 (reduce (fn [acc row]
                                      (let [country (nth row 0)
                                            amount (or (nth row 1) 0)
                                            fraudulent (nth row 2)
                                            prior (get acc country [0 0])]
                                        (assoc acc country
                                               [(+ (nth prior 0) (if fraudulent amount 0))
                                                (+ (nth prior 1) amount)])))
                                    totals rows)]
                (if (get page "next_cursor")
                  (recur (get page "next_cursor") totals2)
                  totals2)))
      options #{"BE" "ES" "FR" "NL"}
      best (reduce (fn [best entry]
                     (let [country (key entry) volumes (val entry)
                           ratio (if (pos? (nth volumes 1)) (/ (nth volumes 0) (nth volumes 1)) 0)]
                       (if (or (nil? best) (> ratio (nth best 1))) [country ratio] best)))
                   nil
                   (filter (fn [entry] (contains? options (key entry))) stats))]
  (return (if (= (nth best 0) "BE")
            ["The REPL aggregation drops the first data row of every page by applying (rest (get page \"rows\")); read-page rows are already aligned data vectors, not a header row. This makes the reported totals incomplete, although the independently recomputed fraud-rate winner is BE (B. BE)."]
            [(str "The independently recomputed fraud-rate winner is " (nth best 0) ", not BE; the analyzer result is wrong.")]))
